complaints.title: Severe Garbage Accumulation & Open Dumping Near Tambaram Railway Station East
complaints.description: Massive overflow of non-segregated household and commercial waste piling onto the pedestrian pathway outside Tambaram East railway station. Stagnant runoff is causing severe foul odors and attracting stray animals. Pedestrians are forced to walk onto the busy vehicular road.
complaints.address: GST Road Exit, Tambaram East Railway Station, Chennai 600059
complaints.officialRemarks: Site inspection conducted on Oct 26. Initial mechanized clearing executed. Partnered with Green Earth Chennai NGO under civic collaboration scheme for sustainable bin infrastructure and daily monitoring.

complaints.title: Overflowing Sewage & Broken Drainage Pipeline on Chromepet Station Road
complaints.description: Underground sewerage line has fractured near the busy market junction on Chromepet Station Road. Dark sewage is flooding into local storefronts and creating a critical health hazard with mosquito breeding.
complaints.address: Station Road Junction, near Chromepet Bus Stand, Chennai 600044
complaints.officialRemarks: Work order #CMWSSB-2026-89 issued. High-pressure jetting machine dispatched. Trench work scheduled for overnight maintenance to minimize traffic bottleneck.

complaints.title: Severe Particulate Smog & Unregulated Open Plastic Burning near Anand Vihar ISBT
complaints.description: Hazardous air quality spikes (AQI 420+) caused by commercial open waste incineration and heavy interstate bus idling without emission filtration. Residents experiencing severe respiratory distress.
complaints.address: Road No. 56, Anand Vihar ISBT Terminal Gate 3, East Delhi 110092
complaints.assignedOfficer: DPCC Environmental Enforcement Inspector S. Verma
complaints.officialRemarks: Anti-smog guns deployed on Road 56. Night thermal patrolling initiated to penalize illegal dumping.

complaints.title: Plastic Debris Bottleneck & Stagnant Stormwater Overflow on Mithi River BKC Connector
complaints.description: Massive single-use plastic accumulations obstructing the flow of Mithi River beneath the BKC bridge. High tide causes toxic black runoff to back up into public cycling tracks and transit lanes.
complaints.address: Mithi River Bridge, Near BKC Connector, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai 400051
complaints.assignedOfficer: MCGM Stormwater Chief Engineer R. Gokhale
complaints.officialRemarks: Trash-skimmer boat operating 6 hours daily. Mumbai Waterfronts Action Network NGO deploying floating boom barrier.

complaints.title: Toxic Chemical Foam Eruption & Weed Choking at Bellandur Lake Outflow
complaints.description: White chemical foam billowing 8 feet high over the outflow weir and drifting across pedestrian pathways on Yemalur road. Severe foul odor and eye irritation reported by residents in nearby tech parks.
complaints.address: Yemalur-Bellandur Lake Spillway, Outer Ring Road corridor, Bengaluru 560037
complaints.officialRemarks: Continuous aeration pumps running. Co-partnering with Bengaluru Lakes & Civic Forum to remove invasive hyacinth.

complaints.title: Untreated Raw Sewage Inflow & Water Hyacinth Proliferation in Musi Riverbed
complaints.description: Black water effluent pouring from open stormwater inlets into Musi river near Nayapul. Dense mosquito breeding and foul odor covering the historic bazaar belt in Old City.
complaints.address: Nayapul Bridge, Near Salar Jung Museum, Old City, Hyderabad 500002
complaints.officialRemarks: HMWSSB sewerage diversion plan under engineering survey.

complaints.title: Solid Waste Piling and Plastic Clogging along Adi Ganga (Tolly’s Nullah) Embankment
complaints.description: Severe accumulation of uncollected household waste, clay idols remnants, and polythene blocking the historic tidal canal. Stagnant brackish water causing health risks for surrounding neighborhoods.
complaints.address: Kalighat Bridge Bank, Tolly’s Nullah Embankment, South Kolkata 700026
complaints.assignedOfficer: KMC Solid Waste Borough VIII Team
complaints.officialRemarks: Mechanical dredging excavator mobilized. Bio-retaining nets installed at two bridges.

referrals.complaintTitle: Severe Garbage Accumulation & Open Dumping Near Tambaram Railway Station East
referrals.actionMandate: Immediate mechanized waste clearance, installation of 4 compactor bins, and daily monitoring with NGO partnership.

referrals.complaintTitle: Severe Particulate Smog & Unregulated Open Plastic Burning near Anand Vihar ISBT
referrals.actionMandate: Deploy water mist cannons, enforce night patrolling for illegal burning, and inspect emission filters on interstate buses.

referrals.complaintTitle: Toxic Chemical Foam Eruption & Weed Choking at Bellandur Lake Outflow
referrals.actionMandate: Run bio-aeration pumps, clear floating water hyacinth, and seal unauthorized industrial chemical drainage pipes.
